landing.heroTitle: Know who you helped, with what, and when.
landing.heroBody: Amanah replaces paper records, spreadsheets and WhatsApp threads with one trusted place to register beneficiaries, track recurring needs and record every distribution.
landing.featuresTitle: Built for the daily work of aid teams
landing.featuresBody: Charities, mosques and community groups use Amanah to stop duplicate aid and forgotten cases.

profiles.title: Central beneficiary profiles
profiles.body: Personal details, needs, full distribution history, documents and notes, all in one profile.

recurring.title: Recurring needs that don't slip
recurring.body: Monthly rent, weekly medicine, yearly school fees: see what is due or overdue at a glance.

distributions.title: Every distribution recorded
distributions.body: Cash or in-kind, with amount, date, proof photo and who delivered it.

duplicates.title: Avoid duplicate aid
duplicates.body: Get warned when a family already received the same support recently.

roles.title: Roles & audit trail
roles.body: Admins, field collectors and read-only viewers, with a log of every important action.

mobile.title: Made for phones
mobile.body: Field workers register cases and record deliveries on the go, in English or Arabic.

landing.transparencyBody: Share a public page with aggregate impact figures. No names, phone numbers or documents are ever exposed.
transparencyPoints: Always anonymous, always up to date
landing.ctaBody: Set up your organization in a minute and invite your team.

public.subtitle: Public transparency report
public.disclaimer: All figures are aggregate totals. No personal information is shared.
